speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I heard you walking. Quick, and then a stop, and then quick again. I want the matter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two great houses, in one town. Alike in everything. A quarrel so old nobody knows the cause.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Servants in the street, then, if the houses are that proud.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Their servants fight in the street. The Prince promises death for the next.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the Prince is the only man in it with sense, and I suppose he is not the chief part.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am to play him, Mistress.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then speak up. A sensible man who cannot be heard is only sensible in the tiring-house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is out. Shall I set it to the board?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Set it to the notch. I will not guess when I own a mark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It wants a full thumb. I can see that from here.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It wants a full thumb. Mark me, by Michaelmas we'll be eating the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The price is still the penny. I am not writing a new one because the crumb has shrunk.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The penny stays. The thumb is the news. Sit, and do not tell me the houses again until you can say which of them is fed.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: After the bread, a knot. You have been easier to sit beside since the proclamation forgot me. I will spend the ease on a length of thrum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Show it. I have had enough of princes for one table.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A weaver's knot. It passes the reed and does not catch. See the loop. Draad. Spoel. Knoop.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thread. The shuttle. The knot. Say them slower. My hand is a player's hand.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Draad, spoel, knoop. Thread, shuttle, knot. Tie it four times. The reed is not impressed by the first success.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once. It caught. Twice. It sat wrong. Three. Hold the end.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Four. Now it will pass. You tied the fourth as if you meant it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Let me. I have been looking at the loop.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Once, then. And do not look pleased if it holds.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It holds.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She is pleased, and she is quiet about it. That is the instruction, half kept.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Half kept is a fair bargain. Three words. He says the shuttle sings. I said sings. Write it under words if you write it at all.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Under Words. Thrum. A weaver's knot. And that the shuttle sings. I am not copying a threat onto that page.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the threat where I heard it. Speak up when you play him. That is the part I will ask you about.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will speak up. The loaf is a thumb short. The knot has been tied four times, and once more by a maid who was told not to look pleased.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Four times is the lesson. One time is her pride. Both are true. Draad, spoel, knoop.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am not looking pleased.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are clearing the board, which is better. The penny loaf is still a penny. Michaelmas can make its own threat when it arrives.
